description_en: Applies an alert template to an application group to generate alert rules
description_zh: 将报警模板应用到应用分组，生成报警规则
name: ApplyMetricRuleTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The mute for. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400.

If the monitoring data continuously exceeds the threshold of the alert rule, the system sends only one alert notification within each epoch
parameters.help_zh:
通道沉默周期。单位：秒。默认值：86400。

当监控数据持续超过报警规则阈值时，每个沉默周期内只发送一次报警通知
parameters.name: silence_time

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an application group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115032.html
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组ID。

关于如何获取应用分组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115032.html
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert template.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an alert template, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114982.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警模板ID。

关于如何获取报警模板ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114982.html
parameters.name: template_ids

parameters.help_en: The start time of the effective period for the alert, in hours. The value is a two-digit string, such as "00", "09", or "23". Valid values: 00 to 23, which represent 00:00 to 23:00. The default time zone is UTC+8
parameters.help_zh: 报警生效的开始时间（小时）。格式为两位数字字符串（如 "00"、"09"、"23"），取值范围为 00~23，代表 00:00 至 23:00。时区默认为 UTC+8（北京时间）
parameters.name: enable_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the effective period for the alert, in hours. The value is a two-digit string, such as "00", "18", or "23". Valid values: 00 to 23. The value specifies the hour of the end time, and the actual effective period ends at the 59th minute of the hour. For example, "23" indicates that the effective period ends at 23:59. The default time zone is UTC+8
parameters.help_zh: 报警生效的结束时间（小时）。格式为两位数字字符串（如 "00"、"18"、"23"），取值范围为 00~23。该值表示结束时间所在的小时，实际生效截止至该小时的 59 分（例如 "23" 表示生效至 23:59）。时区默认为 UTC+8（北京时间）
parameters.name: enable_end_time

parameters.name: notify_level

parameters.help_en:
The application mode of the template. Valid values:

GROUP_INSTANCE_FIRST: application group instances take precedence. When the alert template is applied, the instances in the application group take precedence. If an instance specified in the template does not exist in the application group, the rule for the instance in the template is ignored.

ALARM_TEMPLATE_FIRST: alert template instances take precedence. When the alert template is applied, alert rules are created regardless of whether the instances exist in the application group
parameters.help_zh:
模板应用方式。取值：

GROUP_INSTANCE_FIRST：应用分组实例优先。应用报警模板时，以应用分组实例优先，如果应用分组中不存在该实例，则忽略模板中的规则。

ALARM_TEMPLATE_FIRST：报警模板实例优先。应用报警模板时，不管应用分组中是否存在该实例，都创建报警规则
parameters.name: apply_mode

parameters.help_en: The webhook URL to which a POST request is sent when an alert is triggered
parameters.help_zh: 报警发生时会回调指定的URL地址并发送POST请求
parameters.name: webhook

parameters.help_en:
The application policy of the template. Valid values:

all: deletes all rules created by using alert templates on the selected group and then creates new alert rules based on the template. This is the default value.

append: deletes the rules created by using the current alert template on the selected group and then creates new alert rules based on the current template
parameters.help_zh:
模板应用策略。取值：

all：删除已选择分组上所有通过报警模板创建的规则，然后按模板创建新的报警规则（默认值）。

append：删除已选择分组上通过该报警模板创建的规则，然后按当前模板创建新的报警规则
parameters.name: append_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run and does not bind a security group to the instance. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false: performs a normal request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会为实例绑定安全组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run
